You are the fresh-context checkpoint for Horizon task `ajc-truth` in the Archon Horizon workspace at /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon, project MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge. Read the workspace skill at /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.claude/skills/horizon/SKILL.md if you need orientation. You are read-only on source.

The task's objective: make the project headline, blueprint, and roadmap state the same mathematical claim the Lean dependency graph supports; publish the real axiom frontier with #print axioms; connect Jacobian.lean to landed infrastructure where honest or state precisely what prevents it; re-aim blueprint/hgraph/roadmap/docs at the Milne-Kollar route; keep the I-0372 rational-point-vs-etale-sheafification decision with the human, recording both branches without choosing.

Review MY work this session (run 0054, session 0006-horizon-ajc-truth). My commits, in order:
  a760de640  axiom frontier: root both teams' new modules and measure them
  cb8c2f95d  blueprint: give the committed route its own section
  704325359  headline: leaf C's universal property IS the landed Albanese theorem
  5cff3f47b  blueprint(jacobian): split the Albanese leaf
Also: edits to README.md, TO_USER.md and informal/pic-representability-campaign.md that were swept into a SIBLING's integration commit 72d141876 (recorded as a task comment on ajc-truth).

Please verify, against the actual tree and ledger rather than my description:

1. IS THE AXIOM FRONTIER HONEST? Read scripts/axiom-frontier.lean. I claim it probes 90 declarations, 54 clean and 36 carrying sorryAx, and that counting by output *entry* rather than by *line* matters because Lean wraps long axiom lists. Re-run it (`cd MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge && lake env lean scripts/axiom-frontier.lean`) and check my numbers and my count method. NOTE: other teams share this .lake directory, so a transient missing-.olean error is contention, not breakage — retry.

2. THE MOST IMPORTANT CHECK. I added §6d and §6e claiming a FOURTH trap: an instance binder nothing can instantiate reports clean axioms forever. This came from ajc-rr retracting (inbox I-0418) a claim I had already written into the probe, and a review in I-0415. Verify I actually withdrew the "genuinely unconditional" claim about `hasRationalResidues_of_isAlgClosed` everywhere it appeared, and that what §6d/§6e now say is accurate about that declaration's three instance binders. Did I overcorrect or leave a stale copy?

3. IS THE LEAF-C CONNECTION REAL OR COSMETIC? `AlgebraicGeometry.isAlbanese_pic0_of_isAlgClosed` in AlgebraicJacobian/Jacobian.lean. I claim it proves the factorisation clause of IsAlbanese by applying `Pic0.albanese_universal_property` with NO transport, that it adds no sorry to the file, and that the only content the general leaf adds is arbitrary base field, genus zero, and the basepoint condition. Check the statement is not weaker than it looks (e.g. vacuous hypotheses, or hypotheses that can never be met), and check my docstring's claim that it "discharges nothing" is the honest reading. This is exactly the kind of thing my own §6c traps warn about — apply them to me.

4. ROOT ROLL-UP. I rooted 7 modules into AlgebraicJacobian.lean this session (4 rigid-pushforward + RigidPushforwardInstance + ChartBaseChange + GlobalGeneration + LedgerClosure). Verify: every module I rooted is TRACKED in the ledger (an untracked import breaks a clean checkout), the root build is green, and no module on disk is unrooted except ones that are untracked. Use the standing check in inbox I-0388.

5. BLUEPRINT. Picard_FGAPicRepresentability.tex §sec:fga_pic_milne_kollar (5 new nodes) and Jacobian.tex lem:pic0_isAlbanese_algClosed. Check against .claude/skills/blueprint-conventions/SKILL.md: complete proofs not sketches, no formalization-journal prose, \leanok honest, pins matching the Lean signatures. In particular check thm:rigid_pushforward_locally_free's proof is a real proof and that its \lean pin `Adelic.rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_proved` actually has that statement. Also confirm the blueprint no longer presents the Quot endgame as the live route while not deleting it.

6. IS THE HUMAN DECISION STILL VISIBLE AND UNMADE? I-0372's rational-point vs etale-sheafification choice. Check nothing I wrote quietly assumes a branch.

Report concrete defects with file:line. If you find I have overstated something, say so plainly — that is the single most valuable thing you can return. Do not fix anything.
